question:
Simplify the following expression.

(8 × 8 − 8 + 4) ÷ 10 + (4 × 4 + 4 + 4 ÷ 4) × 3 + 2 of 26 ÷ 4
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Solve brackets first: (8×8−8+4)=60 and (4×4+4+4÷4)=21

Expression becomes: 60÷10 + 21×3 + 2 of 26 ÷ 4

= 6 + 63 + (2×26)÷4

= 6 + 63 + 13

**∴ Answer = 82**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

(8 × 8 − 8 + 4) ÷ 10 + (4 × 4 + 4 + 4 ÷ 4) × 3 + 2 of 26 ÷ 4

**Concept Used:**

BODMAS rule

**Calculation:**

⇒ (8 × 8 − 8 + 4) ÷ 10 + (4 × 4 + 4 + 4 ÷ 4) × 3 + 2 of 26 ÷ 4

⇒ (64 − 8 + 4) ÷ 10 + (4 × 4 + 4 + 4 ÷ 4) × 3 + 2 of 26 ÷ 4

⇒ (56 + 4) ÷ 10 + (4 × 4 + 4 + 4 ÷ 4) × 3 + 2 of 26 ÷ 4

⇒ 60 ÷ 10 + (4 × 4 + 4 + 4 ÷ 4) × 3 + 2 of 26 ÷ 4

⇒ 60 ÷ 10 + (16 + 4 + 4 ÷ 4) × 3 + 2 of 26 ÷ 4

⇒ 60 ÷ 10 + (20 + 4 ÷ 4) × 3 + 2 of 26 ÷ 4

⇒ 60 ÷ 10 + (20 + 1) × 3 + 2 of 26 ÷ 4

⇒ 60 ÷ 10 + 21 × 3 + 2 of 26 ÷ 4

⇒ 6 + 21 × 3 + 2 of 26 ÷ 4

⇒ 6 + 63 + 2 of 26 ÷ 4

⇒ 6 + 63 + 52 ÷ 4

⇒ 6 + 63 + 13

⇒ 82

**∴ The correct answer is 82.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

BODMAS Full Form

Brackets, Orders, Division, Multiplication, Addition, Subtraction

Bracket Priority

Solve brackets first, then division and multiplication left to right

'of' Operation

The word 'of' means multiplication and is solved before division

Simplification Trick

Always simplify inner brackets completely before moving outside
